meta.description: SOPRO Q Series smart lighting: soft, eye-friendly magnetic track lights, downlights and spotlights with no main light, 1,000-level dimming and Zigbee 3.0 control.
meta.spec.description: SOPRO Q Series specifications: dimensions, CRI, power, color temperature, luminous flux, installation and smart control for every track light, downlight and spotlight.

smart lighting with no main light

sec1.item_info:
Gentle fade-in,

sec2.title: Bringing millions of homes
sec3.title: Gentle fade-in, no glare
sec3.desc: Switching on a light at night changes the brightness too fast and strains your eyes. Soft light that fades in takes care of them.
sec4.title: No glare in everyday life
sec4.desc: A shielding angle of up to 35° means no glare at all when you look straight ahead; professional tests put the glare rating at UGR<9*.
sec5.title: Soft light pools, no harsh edges
sec5.desc: No secondary halos: even, soft transitions blend the light naturally into the room.
sec6.title: 4 ways to control, smarter and simpler
sec6.item_info:
Lights on by voice, instantly
no extra words needed
sec6.item_info2:
Classic buttons
even grandparents can use
sec6.item_info3:
Touchscreen light control
fine-tune the ambience
sec6.item_info4:
Remote control in the app
no more lights left on
sec7.title: 30+ professional lights for a stunning ambience *
sec7.redmind: *Each Q Series light has a single color temperature, available in 3000K, 4000K or 6000K
sec8.title: Endless scenes for a lovelier home
sec9.title: Choose a beauty filter for your home
sec9.desc: Each color temperature has its own mood
sec10.title: High-quality light that lasts 50,000 hours
sec10.desc: Custom integrated COB LEDs extend the life of the light: high efficacy, lower energy use, long life and lasting durability
sec11.title: True colors show makeup as it really is
sec11.item_desc: Poor color rendering: objects lose their true colors
sec11.item_desc2: Strong color rendering: objects show their true colors
sec11.desc: It recreates natural light to show your beauty clearly
sec11.remind: * Chromaticity tested to the IES TM-30-15 standard.
sec12.title: No visible flicker at any brightness
sec12.desc:
Research shows that harmful flicker in lights strains the eyes and can damage them, even causing myopia.
A flicker-free driver takes better care of your eyes.
sec13.title: Fits any ceiling and any installation
sec13.item_desc:
A compact track that mounts directly once power is in place.
For homes with no false ceiling, or already finished.
sec13.item_desc2:
A discreet, neat track set into the ceiling.
For renovations where the ceiling is already done.
sec13.item_desc3:
A discreet, neat track built into the ceiling.
For renovations before the ceiling is finished.
sec13.banner_title: Wireless, as easy to fit as a regular light
sec13.banner_desc: Quick, simple installation with no special wiring; scenes are easy to set up, with no programming or other complex steps.
page_footer.footer_info: * The Soft Light series includes magnetic spotlights, magnetic grille lights, magnetic folding grille lights, magnetic floodlights, downlights and spotlights: 8 light types in 3 color temperatures, 24 light heads in all. Magnetic tracks come in ultra-thin surface-mounted, recessed and plaster-in versions, with a range of accessories. Power supplies come in surface-mounted and concealed versions, with a range of accessories.
page_footer.footer_info3: * Each downlight and spotlight can be controlled on its own. Magnetic track lights need a dimming module, which dims the whole track together.
